messages:
Olivia: CI microbench failed on PR #16089 — kernel fanout path shows tail-latency +28% vs main. test: runtime/microbatch_kernel_perf.py::test_kernel_fanout
CI-bot: build 5078901234: perf-regression alert: metric=tail_latency p95/p99 diff +42% / +42% (threshold 10%) link: https://ci.internal/5078/build/5078901234
Morgan: repro logs? can you paste the microbench output? @Kevin might have context
Olivia: pasted outputs below:
```
=== kernel_fanout_256x32 ===
main: p95=12.4ms p99=18.9ms
PR:   p95=17.6ms p99=26.8ms
delta: +42% p95, +42% p99
commit: afd3c9d -> changes kernel autoselect heuristics
config: seq_len=256 batch=32
```
Kevin: ran local perf-run — seeing similar numbers. Looks like the autoselect tweak is routing more to the fanout kernel for medium seqs. Also KV cache hit-rate dropped ~7% which increases overall token work.
Zhen: can you run the compare bench with explicit flags? e.g. `bench --regression-compare main...HEAD --tag=kernel-fanout --warmup 5` and capture perf profile (flamegraph)?
Olivia: did that. quick flame top 10 (high-level):
```
top functions:
runtime::kernel_fanout::execute (45%)
batcher::route (22%)
kv_cache::lookup (12%)
quant::dequantize (6%)
others (15%)
```
Leo: batcher::route at 22% is a red flag — new heuristic probably adds extra routing cost per request. Combined with KV misses = more work in fanout path => higher tail.
Morgan: is this a rollout blocker? If Dedicated SLA customers see this spike we should stop canary.
Olivia: yes this is a rollout blocker for Dedicated and Hosted canaries. I'll start a bisect locally to confirm the offending commit.
Kevin: quick check: afd3c9d changes `autoselect_threshold` and adds `prefer_fanout_for_midseq` flag. When enabled, routing tilts toward fanout even for batches with mixed seq lengths. That could explain KV churn.
Zhen: plan: 1) bisect afd3c9d -> HEAD to confirm 2) if confirmed open revert PR 3) add regression test that asserts p95 delta < 10% and KV hit-rate drop < 3% for kernel_fanout workload 4) implement safer fallback so runtime can force legacy kernel when tail>threshold.
Olivia: bisect started — local bisection shows commit afd3c9d is the first bad commit. Re-running microbench with afd3c9d reverted gives p95 back to 12.6ms.
Kevin: confirm. I'll prepare a revert PR now. Also crafting a minimal patch that disables `prefer_fanout_for_midseq` behind feature flag and adds telemetry.
Morgan: I'll hold the merge queue and notify release leads. Can we gate canary until revert lands?
ci-ops: canary freeze requested for PR 16089. Freezing canary rollout and notifying infra on-call. :white_check_mark:
Olivia: opening revert PR and will attach perf run artifacts + flamegraphs. After revert we can iterate on a safer heuristic with tests.
Kevin: follow-up: add a microbench harness assertion and a unit-level kv-hit regression detector in CI to catch this class of regressions.
Zhen: thanks all — post the revert PR link here when done and I'll help validate the fixes on Dedicated infra.
Olivia: will do. Thread will track bisect logs, revert PR, and new regression tests.
